methodology.purpose: Prevent Weeks 1-6 and Weeks 1-8 team styles from being attributed to an opening caller after an in-window handoff.
methodology.scope: Complete through Week 8 for the 2025 target season. The unresolved Giants preseason assignment is handled separately as an all-window identity exclusion.
methodology.audit_protocol: Start from the June 25 all-team preseason census; search every team and named caller for a handoff, firing, or reassignment through Week 8; verify positive hits with official-club reporting; use later all-team midseason reporting as a completeness cross-check.
methodology.rule: Exclude the entire team-window when the replacement first called plays on or before the window end.
methodology.known_later_changes: Cleveland's handoff to Tommy Rees began in Week 10 and Detroit's Dan Campbell takeover began after Week 8, so neither contaminates the requested windows.

audit_sources.purpose: Cleveland change began in Week 10, outside the supported windows
Detroit change occurred after the supported windows

changes.reason: The Titans officially transferred play-calling from Brian Callahan to Bo Hardegree after Week 3, with Hardegree first calling plays in Week 4. Neither Weeks 1-6 nor Weeks 1-8 is a clean opening-caller target.
